findings.summary: The request error banner uses hardcoded Tailwind red utilities (bg-red-500/10, text-red-700) instead of the design system's danger tokens, breaking dark-theme adaptation and brand consistency.
findings.fix: Replace with token-based classes, e.g. className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--danger)]/30 bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-3 text-sm font-bold text-[var(--danger)]" and add role="alert" for accessibility.

findings.summary: The page builds a bespoke filter-bar (raw search input + custom chip row) instead of reusing the shared FilterBar primitive, losing its clear-all control, result-count (resultText/aria-live), and standardized layout.
findings.fix: Refactor to <FilterBar searchValue={search} onSearchChange={setSearch} searchPlaceholder="ابحث بالاسم أو كود الموظف أو الإدارة…" resultText={`${visible.length} نتيجة`} isDirty={search !== '' || filter !== 'all'} onClear={() => { setSearch(''); setFilter('all'); }}> and pass the filter chips as children.

findings.summary: The map legend swatches use hardcoded bg-emerald-500 / bg-amber-500 rather than the success/warning design tokens, so the legend colors can drift from the actual map pins and won't adapt to theme.
findings.fix: Use bg-[var(--success)] and bg-[var(--warning)] to match the token-driven .map-pin styles in styles.css (which already use var(--danger) etc.).

findings.summary: The load-error state reuses EmptyState (a neutral 'no data' component) rather than the app's error-banner pattern, so a genuine failure looks indistinguishable from an empty result.
findings.fix: Render a token-based error banner (border-[var(--danger)]/30 bg-[var(--danger-soft)] text-[var(--danger)], role="alert") with a retry button calling query.refetch(), consistent with other pages' error handling.

findings.summary: The error message paragraph is inserted dynamically but has no role/aria-live, so screen readers won't announce a failed request submission.
findings.fix:
Add role="alert" (or aria-live="assertive") to the error

so submission failures are announced.

findings.summary: Filter state is expressed only via chip highlight (is-active) with no result count feedback near the filters, unlike the FilterBar pattern which shows resultText via aria-live; the '{visible.length} نتيجة' count lives far away in the directory header.
findings.fix: Surface the result count through FilterBar's resultText (see line 72 fix) so filtering feedback is co-located and announced to assistive tech.

findings.summary: The loading skeleton renders three placeholder blocks but the surrounding directory card header ('دليل الموظفين' / result count) still shows a stale '0 نتيجة' during load, producing a flicker between load and data.
findings.fix: Guard the header count with query.isLoading (e.g. show '…' or hide the count line while loading) so the count doesn't display 0 before data resolves.
